title: Replace raw Color(0xFF...) literals in core/widgets with AppColors/AppTheme constants (stat_card.dart duplicates AppColors.blueNavy verbatim)
why: This is exactly what the no_color_literal_outside_theme custom_lint rule exists to catch, but custom_lint is currently broken (analyzer version mismatch, baselined separately) so nothing flags it today. stat_card.dart:89,104 duplicate AppColors.blueNavy's exact hex (0xFF03174C) as an inline literal instead of referencing it; preference_list_tile.dart:79 and preference_segmented_tile.dart:90 independently hardcode the identical 0xFF929BAA. The concrete cost: a rebrand of AppColors.blueNavy or of the settings-tile subtitle grey silently misses these inline copies, producing a visibly inconsistent surface next time the palette shifts.
recommendation: Promote the duplicated literals (0xFF03174C, 0xFF929BAA) to named AppColors constants and reference them from both files; name or fold the remaining one-off literals in stat_card.dart/preference_segmented_tile.dart/app_dialog.dart.
acceptance_criteria: grep for `Color(0xFF` in lib/core/widgets/ returns no matches for the 3 currently-duplicated values (0xFF03174C, 0xFF929BAA) once fixed.
Once custom_lint_core/analyzer versions are reconciled (tracked separately), no_color_literal_outside_theme passes clean on these files.
